_doc: chasm v1 shape study. All lengths mm, angles deg, unless the key says otherwise. Frame per half = keys_8.json frame (x right, y back, origin key-area bbox centre); z up, z=0 = case bottom face (before feet). Blender scene units: metres (mm * 0.001).

inputs._note: gull = cubic Bezier from vertex (0,0) via c1, c2 to tip, right wing, y up (brand/gull_logo.py); left wing = mirror in x

case._height: flat case, bottom face to top face of the frost frame
case._wall_t: frost wall thickness, outline inset -> cavity
case._lip_bottom_z: underside of the top frame lip (cavity ceiling); plate top 16.1 + 1.4 gasket gap
case._bezel_min: self-check: min distance key pitch box -> outline (corner arcs cut the 6/7 mm sides to ~5.8)
case._opening_clearance: top opening = outline edges pulled back to (bezel - clearance); i.e. ~1 mm around the pitch boxes
case._opening_inset: SUPERSEDED for the top frame by the stagger-hugging opening (blender/out/opening.json from outline.opening); kept only as a fallback
case._opening_r_min: min corner radius of the opening (CNC inner radius)
case._edge_fillet: round on every outer/opening edge of the frost shell

outline._doc: edges CCW. n_deg = outward normal; keys = which keys the line must clear (all | straight | angled | id list | not:id list); bezel = gap from the furthest key pitch box; r = fillet at the END of this edge (vertex to next edge)

case._opening_close_r: morphological closing radius of the opening: fills wedges/gaps between key blocks narrower than 2r; keeps the row stagger steps (Duo frame hugs the keys)
case._opening_tol: polyline simplification tolerance of the raster-derived opening
case._opening_frame_min: self-check: min frost frame width between outline and opening

stack._doc: z of layer bottoms/tops in the half frame (z=0 case bottom face, before feet)
stack._weight: polished stainless slab sits on the bottom
stack._battery: LiPo pouch beside the weight (stepped cavity, cad-gates)
stack._rf_module: RF module on the PCB underside, can faces down (visible through clear bottom)
stack._pcb: 1.6 mm white soldermask; 9.5 leaves ~2.5 mm for hot-swap sockets + foam above the weight
stack._plate: PP 1.5 mm; plate top - PCB top = 5.0 (MX)
stack._cap_bottom: keycap skirt bottom = plate top + 6.0 (assumed seat height)

switch._bottom: bottom housing below plate top (through the 14 mm cutout), sits on the PCB
switch._top: top housing above plate: base square, top x/y, height (cad-gates ~6.6)
switch._stem: stem cross bounding box above the top housing (x, y, h)

stab._spacing: stab stem spacing per cap width (Cherry std)
stab._housing: plate-stab housing stand-in (x, y, z above plate top)
stab._wire: wire just above the plate top, offset to the front

keycap._top_shrink: base minus top in x / y (12.7 x 14.4 top on 1u)
keycap._top_back_shift: top surface centre shifted toward the back
keycap._dish: cylindrical dish depth (cylinder axis along y)
keycap._wall: shell thickness (hollow cap, X-Ray look shows the switch)

rows._doc: h = height at top centre above the cap bottom; tilt = top normal tilted toward the user (-y); R4 = every other key

legend._margin: from the top-surface edge: x, y (top-left for alphas, bottom-left for modifiers)
legend._depth: double-shot: white glyph volume starts this far under the dished top; 0.15->0.08 so it reads through the cap top
legend._style: alpha style = single char or M1-M4 (top-left); arrows centred; other multi-char labels = modifier (bottom-left)

internals._doc: positions in the half frame, mm; rot about z, deg

rf_module._note: E73/MDBT50Q class: metal can + bare antenna strip at the +y end; weight keeps >= 10 mm away. R moved (-78,34)->(-74,32): authored pos violated the cavity-inset-1 assert by 0.64 mm at the antenna corner

weight._doc: outline = case outline edges with every back edge (n_deg 60..120) replaced by one fixed line y = back_y, then inset

usb_c._from_back: port centre measured along the inner edge from its back end

logo._wing_span: vertex to tip in x per wing (C curve is 12 wide -> scale 10/12)
logo._inlay: stainless strip, top flush with the frame top, round ends
logo._vertex_inset: vertex sits this far inside the inner edge (clears the 1 mm edge fillet); 2.0 -> 1.0 so the metal tips nearly meet in together pose
logo._vertex_offset: shift of the vertex along the inner edge, + = toward back; searched -8..+8 in 0.5 mm steps vs the stagger opening -> -3.0 gives L 1.89 / R 1.06 mm clearance at span 10 (blender/tmp/gull_search.json)
logo._anchor: G / H: vertex = anchor key centre projected onto the inner edge line
logo._axis: gull y axis runs along the inner edge direction, wing extends away from the edge into the bezel

feet._typing_angle: placeholder; tilt about the front pads

front_pad._note: 2 per half (front-outer, front-inner), rubber, centre inset from the outline

rear._note: 2 slim bars per half (back-outer, back-inner); height computed so the case sits at typing_angle with bar bottoms flat on the desk (bottom cut at the angle); frost acrylic

tent._angle: roll about the line through the inner front pad + inner rear foot contacts, applied on top of the typing pose
tent._hinge_inset: hinge axis parallel to the outer edge, this far inside it, at z=0
tent._hinge_pos: leg centre as a fraction along the outer edge (0 = front, 1 = back)
tent._deploy: leg angle to the case bottom when deployed; stowed = 0 (flat in a bottom pocket, folding inward)
tent._leg_len: computed so the leg tip touches the desk in the tent pose; tip edge cut parallel to the desk

hub._size: x width, y depth (+y = back), z height
hub._rf: on the PCB top, can up

knob._gap: knob bottom floats this far above the top

gull._note: full gull, both wings, vertex at xy

usb_c._note: back face (+y); same opening/shell as the halves

poses._doc: world placement; each half is first rotated so its inner edge is parallel to world y (align), then the pose applies

flat._gap: inner-edge to inner-edge distance at the logo vertex
flat._yaw: extra inward yaw: L rotated -yaw, R +yaw (back ends lean in)

together._seam: inner edges coincident with this gap, logo vertices aligned

tented._half: tented half for shot 3; the other half stays in the flat pose

underside._half: half flipped onto its cap tops for shot 5

materials._doc: look parameters (Principled BSDF inputs unless noted); tune in look-dev, keep the tuned values here

frost_acrylic._note: full frost; vol scatter 10 gives the thickness glow; A/B look test blender/tmp/look_frost_*.png (B chosen)

abs_clear_frosted._note: X-Ray frosted clear; look test blender/tmp/look_caps_*.png (C chosen)

legend_white._note: opaque white glyph; slightly glossier than cap frost for relief contrast

black_glass._transmission: smoked window: transmits the emissive OLED behind it

antenna_fr4._note: RF module antenna strip (dark green FR4)

render._grade: muted: saturation multiplier + slight black lift in the compositor
render._blur_glossy: clamps glossy fireflies from the clear cap/stack light paths

key_light._note: big softbox front-left high (window feel); 900 was blowing out the frost at draft

backdrop_light._note: faint wash aimed high on the seamless wall; just lifts the backdrop edge, does not flatten it

neg_fill._note: dark card opposite the key: gives the frost walls/caps tonal separation; invisible to camera

grad_card._note: emission gradient plane high/front-left: polished metal (knob, weight, gull) reflects a gradient instead of void; invisible to camera

shots._doc: per-shot camera + pose. cam/target in mm, world space (target may be an object name). support: 'desk' (z=0) or 'plinth' (z=plinth top). Numbers tuned against draft renders.

3_plinth._note: cam z near plinth top (70 mm) -> plinth front edge reads as the horizon line

assumptions: Corner radii 7 mm (outer), 40 mm concave front kink, 60 mm gentle back kink, 16 mm arrow-shoulder concave: shape-study values, not engineering.
L half bottom-left (below M4, left of Ctrl): outline kept square (Duo-like slab), the opening follows the same edges so the plate shows there.
R half arrow cluster: outer edge steps out via a 40 deg shoulder that touches the Right-arrow pitch box corner.
L inner bottom corner chamfered (322 deg edge) to follow Space/B instead of leaving a wide pad.
Keycap seat height = plate top + 6.0 mm; Cherry row heights R1 9.4 / R2 7.9 / R3 7.6 / R4 8.1 mm and top tilts 8/4/0/-5 deg are approximations (no datasheet).
Single legend per key (no shifted symbols); Segoe UI Semibold stands in for the X-Ray kit font.
Switch plate holes boolean-cut; no hot-swap sockets, diodes or wiring modelled.
RF module 13 x 18 mm near the inner back corner on the PCB underside; antenna at the +y end.
Weight = outline inset 12 mm with its back edge at y = 10 mm (clears battery and RF module); 4 mm thick.
Rear feet height derived from the typing angle; tent legs: 1 per half, 50 mm wide, stainless, length derived from the 12 deg tent.
Tent pose ignores rubber compression; roll axis = line through the inner front pad + inner rear foot contacts.
Hub internals beyond PCB + RF module + OLED + encoder body are not modelled.
